invariants.rationale: The method is expected to return meaningful write metadata, which should not be null if execution completes normally.
The returned object should always be an instance of HoodieWriteMetadata as per the declared return type.
The collection of WriteStatus objects within the metadata should be present to describe the result of the write.
The number of write statuses should never be negative, since it is a list size.
A non-empty write status list is expected for a successful upsert operation.
